items.name: Control plan reaction plan
items.value: Stop production, quarantine parts, do not ship, follow QA.01.00.00 'Non-conforming Material Management'.

items.name: Geometry EP
items.value: Run master parts from table (page 2/2 of EP instructions) and confirm they are rejected.

items.name: 2D Code EP step 1
items.value: Run a good part -> must be accepted, PN correct.

items.name: 2D Code EP step 2
items.value: Run a blank (no 2D code, laser disabled) -> must be rejected.

items.name: 2D Code EP step 3
items.value: Run master with damaged 2D code (laser disabled) -> must be rejected.

items.name: 2D Code EP step 4
items.value: Run already heat-treated part of same PN -> must be rejected.

items.name: EP location and failure reaction
items.value: EP verification is performed before the DataMatrix reader at induction station entrance. On EP failure: inform Team Leader + call ME; do not start production until EP is positive.

items.name: OPD measurement plan
items.value: Measure OPD over 2 gage pins on a lot of 5 parts before heat treatment and after heat treatment (same parts, 0 deg and 90 deg angles).

items.name: OPD pin diameters
items.value: per program table (e.g. 2.00-2.002 mm)
items.notes: Stated as an example in the source; actual pins are part-dependent. See NV-014.

items.name: Spline Go/NoGo decision rule
items.value: Go gage full length -> Good part. NoGo freely in full length -> Scrap / re-evaluate by QA, PE & ME. If NoGo goes only 20 % max -> keep as good part.

items.name: OPD part marking
items.value: Mark bearing face with a dot; parts numbered 1-5.

items.name: Gage SG 699436 step 1
items.value: Align gage spline with part spline; let part descend by own weight.
items.notes: Gage instructions GOP34413754 Rev 1 (5/2/2025). Photo-confirmed at file '4.21.03 PM (8).jpeg'.

items.name: Gage SG 699436 step 2
items.value: Check 8 mm thickness gage between thread end and gage surface -> if thickness gage bigger than distance, reject.

items.name: Gage SG 699436 step 3
items.value: Check with NoGo gage GA-780063 -> gage must not go.

items.name: Gage SG 699436 step 4
items.value: Mark OK part with 'V' and place in WIP trolley.

items.name: OK/NOK Inductor / coil alignment
items.value: OK: coil centered on part axis. NOK: coil offset / tilted.
items.notes: VAS34402926_001 / NPS.00.01.02, Zone: Hot Zone. Photo-confirmed at file '4.21.02 PM (1).jpeg'.

items.name: OK/NOK Part seating on fixture

items.name: OK/NOK Bell quench shower contact

items.name: OK/NOK Heated part color (bell)

items.name: OK/NOK Stem heat zone

items.name: OK/NOK 2D code after mark

items.name: OK/NOK Unloading orientation

items.name: Crack Reaction Plan - immediate action
items.value: If cracks appear: stop machine, inform TL / QT / TE, then execute checks CR-001..CR-014.

items.name: Crack check 2

items.name: Crack check 3
items.value: Check quench condition / contamination.

items.name: Crack check 4
items.value: Check paper filter presence & function.

items.name: Crack check 5
items.value: Check oil skimmer presence & function.

items.name: Crack check 6
items.value: Check shower flow, orientation, alignment, clogging.

items.name: Crack check 7
items.value: Check coil position, centering, alignment, condition.

items.name: Crack check 8
items.value: Check coil internal shower tube.

items.name: Crack check 9
items.value: Check process parameters.

items.name: Crack check 10
items.value: Check rings change follow-up.

items.name: Crack check 11
items.value: Check METLab results (case depth at 4 mm).

items.name: Crack check 12
items.value: Check region S (heat, scratch, other surface defect).

items.name: Crack check 13

items.name: Crack check 14
items.value: Check blank chemical composition & blank part defects.

items.name: Crack systemic actions
items.value: CRIB tool receiving inspection; coil condition control every last shift of the week; shower orientation/alignment control in PM2.

items.name: Start-Stop Instruction (STR34407290 / PRO.01.00.10)
items.value: Power on -> check E-stops -> pull air valve -> HMI boot -> Reset -> Homing. Shutdown: push air valve, E-stop buttons, main power off.

items.name: Interrupted Cycle (RIC34402309 / RIC34401371)
items.value: Manual mode -> run pumps + all showers 3 min -> open doors, remove parts (reuse non-HT, scrap HT parts) -> Reset x2 -> restart. For simpler line: clear errors -> Safety Reset -> Auto-Start x2.

items.name: RIC34401371 step 1
items.value: If the cycle is interrupted, clean all errors. ('Si le cycle est interrompu, supprimer toutes les erreurs')
items.notes: Read directly from photo '4.21.02 PM (10).jpeg' (doc PRO.01.00.10 Rev 3 25.10.2020, RIC34401371, revision date 16/12/2024/05).

items.name: RIC34401371 step 2
items.value: Click on Reset button (Safety Reset). ('Appuyer sur Safety Reset')

items.name: RIC34401371 step 3
items.value: Click on Auto-Start button 2 times. ('Appuyer sur le bouton Auto-Start 2 fois')

items.name: Cleanup Instruction (GWI34413351)
items.value: Start-of-shift general check; Friday deep clean exterior; cover all openings; clean polycarbonate screens with mild soap; no abrasives; no pressure jets near motors/electrical; avoid solvents.

items.name: Change Over Instruction (CHO3440796-4)
items.value: Verify PN & mounted coil; change inductor, rings, bottom rings with correct Allen keys; disconnect/reconnect DM water & cooling; use teflon 1 mm gap for coil centering; load new recipe & verify Z2/Z3; run Learn on InduControl; fill Setup Check Sheet.
items.notes: 1 mm teflon gap conflicts with setup-sheet 1.5 mm note (PR-016 / NV-003).

items.name: Sensibilite Check TP & CV (GWI3441351)
items.value: Connect clips coil<->base / coil<->tail stock; close door, release E-stop, reset; verify 'inductor touch' alarm on HMI for STEM and BOWL on both TP and CV. If NOK -> inform TL, Maintenance & TE immediately.

items.name: Washer Nozzles Check (VAS34402948)
items.value: Air-compress nozzles always horizontal; verify parts fully pass blow-off zone; if jammed, adjust nozzle angle so pieces pass smoothly; take before/after photos.

items.name: Hand Refractometer (GWI34413698)
items.value: Run pumps 30 min for homogeneous concentration; zero the refractometer; sample from front-door port; for AQUAQUENCH 251 multiply reading x2 for concentration %.

items.name: Traceability Manual Lot (BLC34402308)
items.value: Directory Screen -> TRACEABILITY -> MANUAL LOT TRACKING -> select PN -> enter lot # twice (or scan label JUK) -> submit.

items.name: Non-Conforming Flow Chart
items.value: Detect suspect product -> identify & label -> inform Team Leader / Technician Quality -> re-verify -> re-introduce only if conforming; else quarantine.

items.name: Fiche de Securite au Poste de Travail (SOP34405838 / EHS.12.00.03)
items.value: Risks: HMI impact, box-on-hold impact, AQUAQUENCH spill/slip, laser exposure, crushing/burns from moving/hot parts, noise >85 dB. PPE: gloves, safety shoes, anti-noise, safety glasses. Alert on safety-latch malfunction.
